headline.purpose: Screen titles on auth and error surfaces.

title.purpose: Brand wordmark, section and card titles.

body.purpose: Default UI text, buttons, table cells.

label.purpose: Field labels, stat-group headings, tab text.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: All Tailwind shadow tokens (sm to 2xl) are set to none. Depth is 1px border plus tonal fill.

motion.name: toggle
motion.purpose: Switch track color and thumb translate.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion, except .animate-spin (becomes ui-busy-pulse, 1.6s opacity) and .animate-pulse (kept).

narrative.overview:
Clumoove is a record of work being done, and the interface reads like one: hairline rules, tabular figures, plain status words, and surfaces that stay still while the numbers move. An operator leaves a migration running overnight and comes back to a page that tells them exactly what happened. The system is sober, exact and trustworthy. It does not perform confidence; it shows evidence.

The palette is a single zinc neutral ramp, with color reserved for state: green for verified, amber for needs attention, red for failed, blue for "your keyboard is here". Depth comes from borders and tonal fills, never shadows. Corners are barely rounded (2 to 8px) so the product feels like infrastructure rather than a consumer app. Light and dark themes are equal citizens and share one token vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by default: 1px borders and tonal fills carry all structure.
One neutral ramp; chromatic color only ever means state or focus.
Poppins for headings, Open Sans for everything else; 12px is the floor.
Dense but breathable: 8px base rhythm, 24px card padding, max-w-6xl page column.
Two themes (data-theme light or dark), one set of semantic tokens.
Motion is minimal; under prefers-reduced-motion everything collapses except busy indicators, which become a slow opacity pulse.

rules.name: The Color-Means-State Rule
rules.body: Chromatic color appears only to report status or mark focus. Decoration is neutral.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Use var(--color-*) semantic tokens, never raw Tailwind palette colors, so both themes stay in lockstep. The switch "on" track is --color-toggle-on.

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below 0.75rem. A global rule lifts legacy text-[9px] to text-[11px] values to 12px.

rules.name: The Locale-Length Rule
rules.body: Every string exists in de and en; layouts must tolerate German being roughly a third longer.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and flat on hover. State is a fill change or an underline, never a shadow, glow or scale.

dos: Do use the semantic tokens (var(--color-bg-secondary), var(--color-text-muted), ...) and the ui-* utilities from frontend/src/index.css for every new surface.
Do express state with a text label plus color (badge, alert); never color alone.
Do style text links as Ink (--color-text-link) with a persistent underline at a 2px offset; hue is never the only link cue.
Do keep 4px radius on controls, 6px on cards, and 1px Rule borders on every raised surface.
Do use @heroicons/react for interface icons, with a localized aria-label and title on icon-only buttons.
Do format numbers, dates and sizes through src/utils/format.ts with the active locale.
Do keep de and en strings in parity and allow roughly 30% extra width for German.
Do give every icon-only control ui-icon-button or ui-touch-target (32px pointer, 44px coarse), and never hide a control behind hover alone.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; new animation must collapse to none, except a busy indicator, which should keep a non-spatial (opacity-only) loop.
donts: Don't reintroduce portal-*, glass-*, shadow-portal*, decorative gradient overlays or heavy backdrop blur.
Don't add shadows, glows or scale-on-hover; depth is border plus tonal fill.
Don't use raw Tailwind palette colors (blue-600, green-500) where a semantic token exists.
Don't introduce a decorative accent hue; chromatic color is reserved for state and focus.
Don't use react-icons outside provider brand logos.
Don't round beyond 8px, except avatars, the progress track and the toggle.
